text:
Sara Li: Heads-up — PelotonPay POC kicks off tomorrow 09:00 PT. Legal still has open items on the SSQ and the customer asked for final pricing for dedicated capacity. Need a quick war-room to clear blockers now.
Jorge Mendez: I can run the tech presales side. Which SSQ items are blocking? can we get the PDF? :eyes:
Legal Review: We left two items: data residency checkbox and logging retention terms. I uploaded the annotated SSQ to Google Drive. Link: https://drive.reddemo/pelotonpay-ssq
Priya Rao: @Legal Review saw the SSQ. For logging retention we can propose 90 days by default and 365 as an add-on. Data residency — PelotonPay needs EU-only. We can offer Private in eu-west-1. Need SOC2 attestation copy.
Alex Chen: Pricing: PelotonPay asked for an RPU-based estimate + a reserved discount. We should give them a 30-day pilot rate and an enterprise committed rate. I put draft numbers in the shared sheet.
Miguel Torres: On the POC runtime, customer reported 429s during burst tests yesterday. Can someone share the proxy logs? I saw metric spikes around 16:12 UTC.
eng-oncall-bot: New alert -> svc-inference-prod: increased 429 rate for model-prod-02 between 2025-11-04T16:10:00Z and 2025-11-04T16:18:00Z. Pager: @eng-oncall
Jorge Mendez: Miguel — paste from the gateway logs here. Also confirm request pattern (concurrent clients + long prompts?).
Miguel Torres: Logs snippet:
```
2025-11-04T16:12:03Z ERROR 429 request_id=abc123 client=pelotonpay instance=model-prod-02 seq=101
2025-11-04T16:12:04Z INFO  batching_size=8 queued=12 latency_ms=240
2025-11-04T16:12:05Z ERROR 429 request_id=abc124 client=pelotonpay
```
Miguel Torres: They were doing 12 concurrent users with long-form generation (avg 800 tokens). Batching hit queue limit -> 429.
Priya Rao: That's expected with default quota. For POC we can temporarily raise soft quota and enable auto-burst. Need an approval from Sales/Finance for extra spend.
Sara Li: I can approve a 48-hour trial burst under the POC credit. Alex — confirm budget and update quote
Alex Chen: Confirmed. Approving up to $2.5k extra pilot spend. Jorge, please coordinate the config change.
Jorge Mendez: I'll toggle auto-burst and increase per-tenant concurrent limit to 20. Command I'll run (patch to deployment):
```
PATCH /api/v1/tenants/pelotonpay/config
{"concurrency_limit":20, "burst_enabled":true}
```
Jorge Mendez: Doing it now — will post status.
eng-oncall-bot: Deployment change scheduled: patch-job-7845 started by jorge.eta ~ 30s
Jorge Mendez: Patch applied. Gateways show queued=2 and no 429s for the last 90s. Can you run the burst test again, Miguel?
Miguel Torres: Re-running. Quick check — streaming responses look fine. No 429s observed in first 3 minutes. :thumbsup:
Legal Review: Also related — customer asked for a clause allowing on-prem data export in emergencies. We need Product sign-off.
Alex Chen: Product ok with export clause but must have approval flow + audit log. @Priya Rao will that require changes to our Private offering docs?
Priya Rao: We'll add audit log requirement to the policy. No code changes required for POC, but for Private deployment we'll need a KMS binding doc.
Sara Li: Great — summarizing action items: (1) Jorge enabled burst and confirmed fix; (2) Legal will update SSQ and send new copy to PelotonPay; (3) Alex will update pricing sheet with pilot add-on and committed discount; (4) Priya to draft KMS/export bullet for Private follow-up. Timeline: deliverables by EOW. Everyone ok?
Miguel Torres: Aye. I'll keep monitoring for 24h and post if anything flares.
Jorge Mendez: I'll schedule a 30min handoff tomorrow 09:30 PT to walk the PelotonPay SREs through rate limits and fallback.
Alex Chen: I'll send the refreshed quote to PelotonPay legal after we get the updated SSQ. Expect email by EOD.
Legal Review: Uploaded updated SSQ v2 to Drive and shared with PelotonPay legal. Noted the export clause with conditional approval steps.
Sara Li: Thanks team — huge help. I'll update the customer and set the 09:30 PT call invite. :partyparrot:
eng-oncall-bot: Alert resolved for svc-inference-prod (429s decreased below threshold). Incident #7845 closed.
Sara Li: Closing thread — will reopen if we see regressions.
